import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u019/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Mark large uniform rectangular patches, discovered by expanding each possible
    # rectangle from its top-left corner.
    marked=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        v=g[r][c]
        for r2 in range(r+3,h):
          for c2 in range(c+3,w):
            if all(g[i][j]==v for i in range(r,r2+1) for j in range(c,c2+1)):
              marked.update((i,j) for i in range(r,r2+1) for j in range(c,c2+1))
    for r,c in marked: g[r][c]=4
    return g
'''
(base/'task-c1cf5b93.py').write_text(code)
